components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clearest next action, used once per local decision group.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(var(--color-accent)); color: rgb(var(--color-accent-foreground)); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(var(--color-accent) / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A contained alternative that remains quieter than the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-border)); border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted) / 0.7); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action for already structured toolbars and surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A clear, labelled field with strong focus and invalid-state recovery cues.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-border)); border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(var(--color-surface)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); font: 400 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--color-text-muted)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: rgb(var(--color-danger)); } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"]:focus-visible { outline-color: rgb(var(--color-danger)); } .ds-input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: One coherent object or task grouped with a single precise boundary.
components.html:
Storage & DVR

Choose where recordings live and how much space SignalHaven may use.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-border)); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(var(--color-surface)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; max-width: 65ch; color: rgb(var(--color-text-secondary)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 24px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A compact semantic label that never relies on color alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-border)); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); font: 500 12px/16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--color-live)); }

components.name: Peer Tabs
components.description: A single quiet rail for peer sections, with one locally elevated selection.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; height: 40px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-secondary)); } .ds-tab { padding: 6px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab:hover { color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); } .ds-tab.is-active { background: rgb(var(--color-surface)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Compact application navigation that stays secondary to the current media task.
components.html: GuideChannelsRecordingsSettings
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: rgb(var(--color-text-secondary)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Modal Dialog
components.description: A clearly elevated, task-focused plane with explicit recovery and dismissal.
components.html:
Record this program?

Choose a one-time recording or create a series rule.
components.css: .ds-modal { width: min(100%, 512px); display: grid; gap: 16px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--color-border)); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(var(--color-surface)); color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); box-shadow: 0 20px 25px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10), 0 8px 10px -6px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.10); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-modal h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 18px; line-height: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-modal p { margin: 0; color: rgb(var(--color-text-secondary)); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; } .ds-modal-actions { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 8px; } .ds-modal button { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-modal-cancel { border: 0; background: transparent; color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); } .ds-modal-cancel:hover { background: rgb(var(--color-surface-muted)); } .ds-modal-confirm { border: 0; background: rgb(var(--color-accent)); color: rgb(var(--color-accent-foreground)); } .ds-modal-confirm:hover { background: rgb(var(--color-accent) / 0.9); } .ds-modal button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: SignalHaven Brand Mark
components.description: The authoritative signal, haven, and playback symbol rendered at application-header size.
components.html: SignalHaven
components.css: .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: rgb(var(--color-text-primary)); font: 600 16px/24px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-brand:hover .ds-brand-mark { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-brand:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(var(--color-accent)); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
SignalHaven is advanced media infrastructure presented as a private broadcast deck: calm, precise, approachable, and dependable. It should feel ready and capable without looking aggressive, ornamental, or needlessly technical. Video is the product's most critical path and the reason the interface exists; whenever media is present, the interface recedes so playback becomes the unmistakable center of gravity.

The system earns polish through refined, restrained components, responsive layouts, legible density, exact state communication, and complete edge-state handling. Familiar system typography, slate surfaces, and purposeful color keep a technically sophisticated homelab product approachable during everyday use.

The brand mark combines signal, haven, and playback: two broadcast arcs sit over a protective lower form with a negative-space play symbol. Production SVGs are authoritative; the concept board at `docs/brand/signalhaven-logo-concept.png` is reference material only.
keyCharacteristics: Content-first composition with compact application chrome.
Video-first hierarchy that protects playback prominence, continuity, and control.
Dense when the task rewards scanning; relaxed when the user is configuring or learning.
Light and dark themes with identical hierarchy and meaning.
Fast, functional motion and explicit reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The One Control Voice Rule
rules.body: Control Blue owns actions, links, selection, and focus. The Signal Cyan family must not become a competing action color.

rules.name: The Meaning Survives Theme Rule
rules.body: Theme changes may alter luminance and contrast, never layout, hierarchy, semantics, or information density.

rules.name: The Contrast Before Identity Rule
rules.body: Identity accents never override accessible text and control tokens. Use the theme-aware Live-on-Signal foreground for content on live-state fills; fixed artwork cyan is not a text color.

rules.name: The Native Speed Rule
rules.body: Use the system stack throughout the application. Do not add a webfont merely to create personality; any future type change must justify its loading, rendering, and legibility cost.

rules.name: The Dense, Not Cramped Rule
rules.body: Reduce chrome before compressing content. Labels must remain readable, and explanatory text keeps a relaxed line height even in compact density.

rules.name: The Content Owns the Viewport Rule
rules.body: Interface chrome must never be the largest, brightest, or most detailed region in the first viewport.

rules.name: The Playback Is the Product Rule
rules.body: When video is present, it receives the strongest hierarchy and the most useful space. Navigation, metadata, and management controls must support playback without competing with it.

rules.name: The Bounded Overflow Rule
rules.body: Only an explicit component such as the guide grid or tab rail may scroll horizontally; page-level horizontal overflow is a defect.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface remains flat unless it represents a distinct object or moves onto a higher interaction plane.

rules.name: The One Boundary Rule
rules.body: Do not stack bordered cards inside bordered cards unless the inner boundary represents a genuinely independent object.

rules.name: The Radius Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Use full pills only for true badges, dots, tracks, or circular controls—not as a generic way to soften every container.

dos: Do let the active task, media, and data own the viewport.
Do give video the strongest hierarchy and protect playback startup, continuity, recovery, and controls as the application's highest-priority experience.
Do preserve identical hierarchy, density, and semantics across light and dark themes.
Do use Control Blue for interaction, reserve the theme-aware Live Signal token for live or healthy application states, and keep fixed Signal Cyan in brand artwork.
Do keep interfaces responsive on realistic homelab hardware and treat loading, recovery, accessibility, and responsive behavior as part of the finished experience.
Do use the committed production mark without redrawing it and test new placements at 16 px as well as their intended size.
Do update this guide, production SVGs, generated raster assets, application metadata, and relevant tests together when approved identity geometry or palette changes.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glows, glass effects, bevels, decorative 3D depth, or detailed imagery behind the mark.
Don't add a persistent desktop sidebar, decorative dashboard shell, status widgets, or storage meters that compete with the current task.
Don't use color alone for state, use fixed artwork cyan as interface text, or allow a second general-purpose action color.
Don't use a separate card for every field, stack boundaries without meaning, or turn every compact shape into a pill.
Don't compress labels, controls, or explanations merely to keep a desktop row intact on narrow screens.

Don't put text inside the favicon or app icon, outline the play cutout, split the haven into competing colors, or replace the mark with a generic broadcast, house, antenna, lighthouse, TV frame, or shield.
Don't change the mark's arc thickness, spacing, corner treatment, play geometry, or component alignment without updating every approved asset and testing favicon, header, and 512 px icon sizes.
